name: conductor
description: Orchestration for Claude Code and Codex. Conductor provides mixed-model lanes and cross-family review; Conductor Core uses Astra at task-appropriate effort with work-sized fan-out, optional Opus design/review, and no Fable dependency; Conductor Claude runs the same workflow entirely on Opus 5 and Fable 5.1 when no Codex quota is available, substituting context-independent cross-model review for the cross-family gate. Both share explanatory reports and task-selected evidence.
